FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.description: The complete Firebase Admin service-account JSON object, including its surrounding braces.

GMAIL_USER.description: Gmail or Google Workspace address used to send verification and account emails.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.description: A Google App Password for GMAIL_USER. Do not use the normal Gmail password.

SITE_URL.description: The public HTTPS URL of this Heroku app, for example https://your-app.herokuapp.com.

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated public hostnames accepted by the app, including your Heroku hostname.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random secret used to sign application sessions.
